title: Entrance wordmark

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study
location.extent: Whole published artwork or representative frame of complete local clip

slide_intent: Test the mark as a physical object because material, light and distance change how lettering is read.
strategic_value: The dimensional black signature can make the venue recognizable before visitors enter.
demonstration: A variable-height Symphony wordmark projects from a pale entrance wall and casts shadows.
practical_value: Compare the letter silhouette and its shadow when translating the mark into dimensional signage.
